incidents.name: CurioDAO DSChief hat takeover and CGT mint
incidents.notes: Curio's MakerDAO-fork DSChief let the attacker lock only 20 CGT and lift() itself to hat because the sitting hat carried a smaller approval, after which DSPause.plot()/exec() with a zero delay delegatecalled an attacker spell that minted ~1B CGT and drained every CGT pool.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim DSChief 0x579a3244f38112b8aabefce0227555c9b6e7aaf0 created 2021-05-24 by 0x63ea2d3fcb0759ab9ad46edc5269d7debd0bdbe6, not by attack sender 0xdaaa6294c47b5743bdafe0613d1926ee27ae8cf5; no upgrade events. lossUsd uses the realized-extraction figure of ~$180k from quadrigainitiative.com rather than the widely quoted $16m, which is the nominal value of the ~1B CGT minted (the attacker still holds most of it and CGT liquidity was thin).
